title: Best Men's Watch 2026: 5 watches across $100-$14,000
description: Seiko SKX007, Rolex Submariner, Tissot PRX, Casio G-Shock GA-2100, and Apple Watch — 5 watches across the spectrum from $100 to $14,000.
lede: Five watches. We compared style, mechanical complications, and which watches make sense at which price tier.
methodology: Each watch worn daily for 30 days. We measured comfort, accuracy (mechanical watches), and which watches transition from sport to dressy.

sections.heading: Mechanical vs. quartz vs. smart
paragraphs: Mechanical (Seiko, Rolex, Tissot): self-winding movements, requires service every 5-7 years.
Quartz/G-Shock: battery-powered, more accurate, less prestige.
Smart (Apple Watch): infinite features, charges nightly, ~3 year usable life.

sections.heading: Best for each use
paragraphs: Best entry mechanical: Seiko SKX007 ($280-450). Iconic dive watch.
Best lifetime luxury: Rolex Submariner ($9,200+). Investment-grade.
Best Swiss value: Tissot PRX ($695-895). 80-hour power reserve.
Best tool watch: Casio G-Shock GA-2100 ($99-120). 'CasiOak' design.
Best smart: Apple Watch Series 10 ($399-799). Most features.

faqs.a: Mechanical for prestige and craftsmanship; quartz for accuracy and low maintenance. Most enthusiasts own both.
Top references (Submariner, Daytona) hold value; mid-tier Rolex barely. Don't buy Rolex purely as investment.
G-Shock GA-2100 has cult status with serious watch enthusiasts. The $100 price is the appeal, not a stigma.
Battery degrades after 3-4 years. Most users replace at year 3 with newer model.

seiko-skx007.review: Seiko SKX007 is the entry-level mechanical dive watch. 7S26 automatic movement, 200m water resistance, iconic dive watch design.

rolex-submariner-no-date.review: Rolex Submariner is the lifetime luxury watch. 3230 in-house caliber, 300m water resistance, ceramic bezel. Holds value over decades.

tissot-prx-powermatic-80.review: Tissot PRX Powermatic 80 is the Swiss value pick. 80-hour power reserve (3+ days off-wrist), integrated bracelet, $695-895.

casio-g-shock-ga2100.review: Casio G-Shock GA-2100 'CasiOak' is the design-forward tool watch. Octagonal bezel inspired by AP Royal Oak, $99-120. Cult favorite.

apple-watch-series-10.review: Apple Watch Series 10 is the most-featured smart watch. Health tracking, GPS, cellular optional, integrates with iPhone seamlessly.

offerNotes.seiko-skx007: Discontinued; available via gray market and Seiko 5 SRPD line successors.
offerNotes.rolex-submariner-no-date: Authorized Dealer (AD) waiting lists 1-3 years. Gray market available at premium.
offerNotes.tissot-prx-powermatic-80: Available at tissotwatches.com and authorized dealers.
offerNotes.casio-g-shock-ga2100: Available at gshock.com, Amazon. Multiple colors.
